description.value: Humboldt Bar is an intimate cocktail bar in downtown Victoria inspired by the life and work of Alexander von Humboldt, the 19th-century German naturalist. Located on the Arcade Level of the DoubleTree Victoria hotel, it offers an immersive nature-themed environment with a creative cocktail program drawing on Humboldt's travels and discoveries. Small plates from the kitchen are also available on most evenings.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 22m; stands (4 spaces) at 41m; rack at 69m; rack at 76m; rack at 93m. Total: 8 spaces.

No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM address omits the city and province ('722 Humboldt Street, V8W1B1'); website confirms full address as '722 Humboldt St, Victoria, BC V8W 1B1' — used website value.
